options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (aria-describedby).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for values in tooltips, labels, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Ids of series (or slices) hidden initially; update() replaces the hidden set.

options.name: slices
options.description: Slices: { id, label, value: number | null, color?: 1-8 }. Negative, null, and non-finite values are not plotted; they are listed in the summary and the table.

options.name: donut
options.description: Render a ring (inner radius 60%).

options.name: centerLabel
options.description: Donut center text. Default: the formatted total of visible slices; empty string: none. aria-hidden (the summary states the total).

options.name: valueLabel
options.description: Data table header of the value column. Default: localized "Value".

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: auto: legend when there is more than one series (pie charts: always).

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback with the exact data: behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

options.name: patterns
options.description: Dash patterns and texture fills so series never differ by color alone. Off by default (plain colors); always on in forced colors. Turn it on when series are told apart by color alone (grouped or stacked series, multi-slice pies) and no labels carry the distinction (WCAG 1.4.1).

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: sliceLabels
options.description: Text printed on slices large enough to hold it.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, date, and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the category/x axis, the value axis side, and Left/Right arrow keys.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Ids of hidden series (slices for Pie Chart).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same data point.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide a series (slice) programmatically; emits no event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-series-toggle
events.detail: { id: string; visible: boolean; hidden: string[] }
events.description: The user toggled a legend entry (pointer or keyboard). Not emitted for update() or setSeriesVisible().

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: PieChartPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-pie-chart
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--patterns
cssClasses.description: patterns option on: dash patterns and textures shown.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__swatch
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden legend and tooltip key (marker, dash, texture).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot classes; set --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__mark / __mark--active / __mark--hover
cssClasses.description: Focusable data mark and its states.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__value-label
cssClasses.description: Printed values with a surface-colored halo.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused mark carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data, All series are hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-pie-chart__slices / __slice-group / __slice / __labels / __center
cssClasses.description: Slice marks, printed labels, and the donut center text.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--no-grid / --gradient / --animate / --entering
cssClasses.description: theme.gridLines: false, theme.gradient, theme.animation (entering: the render that animates).
